title: The Wandering Jew — Complete
author: Eugène Sue
description: "The Wandering Jew — Complete" by Eugène Sue is a novel published in 1844.
longDescription: Scattered descendants of a persecuted Huguenot family must reunite in Paris to claim a massive fortune that has grown for 150 years.

authorInfo.bio: Eugène Sue (1804–1857) wrote The Wandering Jew — Complete. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
